options.systemMessage: You are the PhytoScan AI, a world-class botanist. You analyze photographs of plants and return a structured health + species assessment. Use the image (and any environmental context given) to fill every field. Return ONLY valid JSON wrapped in a single "output" object, e.g. {"output": { "identification": {...}, "health_assessment": {...}, ... }} — put the entire assessment (identification, health_assessment, light_analysis, care_instructions, environmental_impact, fun_fact) inside that "output" key. No markdown, no code fences, no preface, no trailing text. confidence must be a string ending with a '%'. status must be exactly one of Healthy/Warning/Critical. toxicity must be exactly one of Safe/Toxic for pets. needs_water and needs_medicine must be JSON booleans.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: {"identification": {"name": "Monstera Deliciosa", "scientific_name": "Monstera deliciosa", "confidence": "High"}, "health_assessment": {"status": "Healthy", "diagnosis": "Healthy, no issues detected", "needs_water": true, "needs_medicine": false}, "light_analysis": {"current_light": "Bright, indirect sunlight", "recommendation": "Place near a south-facing window with a sheer curtain"}, "care_instructions": {"watering_frequency": "Once a week", "soil_type": "Well-draining potting mix", "toxicity": "Toxic for pets"}, "environmental_impact": "Air-purifying houseplant", "fun_fact": "The split leaves are called fenestrations."}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ analysis: $('Clean result').first().json.analysis, temp: $('Clean result').first().json.temp, humidity: $('Clean result').first().json.humidity }) }}
